useful_delta: Recovered the durable boundaries that a Prompt OS must preserve and tied them to the live Context Foundry substrate. The resulting candidate architecture treats prompts as immutable compiled runtime projections, Cognitive Programs as reusable parameterized procedures, and Recipes as declarative compilation plans. It separates Constitution/Active Method/Product Memory/Campaign/Job/Working Set authority from the runtime prompt, adds explicit provenance and replay manifests, gates program/recipe promotion through evaluation and steward authority, and prevents runtime output from silently becoming durable truth. Literal Prompt OS/Cognitive Programs/Recipes implementations were not found under those names in current default-branch code/history searches, so this return marks the proposed contracts as candidates rather than pretending a canonical implementation already exists.

facts.claim: The binding Big Picture already defines prompts as compilation targets rather than handwritten mega-prompts, names reusable cognitive programs/recipes, and states that the active program is compiled from Constitution + Active Method + Campaign + role/job + Working Set.

The same Big Picture separates Constitution, Active Method, Product Memory, Context Foundry, Campaign/Run, Planner/Compiler, Agent Network, Steward, authority plane and reincarnation; therefore a runtime prompt cannot safely be the canonical store for any of those layers.

Context Foundry v2.1 is reusable implementation substrate for prompt compilation: immutable records, explicit authority ordering, privacy inheritance, currentness/supersession handling, deterministic bounded selection, high-authority conflict failure, inclusion/exclusion explanations, consumption receipts and reopen handles already exist.

The durable survival rules require progressive context, preserve-before-invent, source/evidence reopening, provider/model replaceability, explicit FACT/CANDIDATE/HUMAN_ACCEPTED/CURRENT/SERVED separation, and recovery of the Active Method before material work.

WI-BIG-03 independently recovered the Source Plane lineage and proposed the bounded chain RAW SOURCE -> SOURCE CARD -> RETRIEVAL RECEIPT -> WORKING SET -> COMPILED PROGRAM with replay/freshness/privacy/authority proofs. Prompt OS should consume this boundary instead of embedding its own parallel retrieval truth.

Default-branch code searches for literal Prompt OS, Cognitive Programs, recipe, crystallization, reincarnation and compiler terms, plus commit-message searches for prompt/context/cognitive/recipe, did not reveal a separate canonical Prompt OS/Cognitive Program/Recipe implementation. The recoverable durable specification is therefore stronger than the located implementation lineage for this layer.

authority_model.principle: Compilation may select, order, transform and compress authoritative inputs, but it may not mint or silently upgrade authority. The runtime prompt is a projection, never an authority root.
layers: CONSTITUTION: highest governing invariants and safety/authority rules. Compiler cannot override them.
ACTIVE_METHOD: current promoted method clauses/profiles. Programs may specialize them but not silently erase them.
PRODUCT_MEMORY/SOURCE_PLANE: durable facts, decisions, negative knowledge and evidence with explicit authority/privacy/currentness. Only selected evidence participates.
PROJECT_NORTH/CAMPAIGN: durable objective, phase, gates and campaign constraints.
ROLE/JOB: scoped mission, write boundaries, return contract and execution role.
WORKING_SET: exact bounded evidence selected by Context Foundry/Source Plane for this run.
COGNITIVE_PROGRAM: reusable parameterized procedure describing how to think/act for a class of work; it is method logic, not a truth database.
RECIPE: declarative compile plan that chooses program + required layers + ordering + budgets + adapters + validators.
RUNTIME_PROMPT_ARTIFACT: immutable compiled projection with source refs/digests, compiler/recipe/program identity and unresolved markers; disposable after execution.
OUTPUT/TRACE: execution evidence/candidate result. It cannot write itself back as canonical truth without explicit owner/steward promotion.

cognitive_program.purpose: Reusable cognitive procedure for archaeology, planning, critique, recovery, implementation, integration, verification, reincarnation or context compilation.
cognitive_program.rule: Programs reference durable method clauses and source contracts; they do not copy the entire Constitution/Method/Memory into themselves.

recipe.purpose: Declarative build specification for turning a task into a runtime prompt/program without embedding product truth.
recipe.rule: Recipe changes how context is assembled, not what counts as canonical truth.

minimum_fields: ordered sections/components with origin + authority class
execution trace/eval return refs when available
compiled_prompt_manifest.rule: The manifest, not copied prose alone, is the replay/audit identity for one compilation.

compile_pipeline: 1 RESOLVE: bind project/campaign/run/job/role and intended execution/export target.
2 LOAD AUTHORITY HEADS: resolve exact Constitution, Active Method, campaign/job and relevant policy/owner refs; fail on ambiguous authority where required.
3 SELECT PROGRAM/RECIPE: choose explicit active or pinned candidate versions appropriate to role/task; never newest-wins implicitly.
4 BUILD WORKING SET: delegate source selection to Context Foundry/Source Plane using required evidence slots, authority/currentness/privacy/freshness constraints and deterministic budget receipts.
5 COMPOSE: render ordered prompt sections from authority-separated inputs. Preserve source labels and unresolved/conflict markers through compression.
6 BUDGET: enforce deterministic size/token budgets; dropped material gets an omission reason. Required evidence cannot be silently truncated into apparent closure.
7 ADAPT: apply provider/model/tool-specific syntax only after semantic composition; adapters cannot weaken authority or privacy requirements.
8 PREFLIGHT: validate authority provenance, privacy/export rules, required evidence coverage, conflict state, write scope, output schema and replay identity.
9 FREEZE: emit immutable compiled prompt/program + manifest/digest before execution.
10 EXECUTE + TRACE: record execution identity, tool/worker refs, outputs and failures against compiled_prompt_id.
11 EVALUATE: attach task-specific correctness, safety, context sufficiency, regression and cost/latency observations.
12 PROMOTE CANDIDATES EXPLICITLY: observations may propose program/recipe/method changes, but only the owning steward/human authority promotes them.

durable: Cognitive Program and Recipe definitions + versions + promotion history
Working Set/retrieval receipts when needed for replay/audit
evaluation results, incidents, Goldens/Vaccines and promotion decisions
durable_runtime_separation.boundary_rule: Ephemeral/runtime artifacts may point to durable sources and create durable evidence receipts, but may not become Current/Accepted merely because they executed successfully.

flow: Create candidate program/recipe as a new immutable version; never mutate the active version in place for material changes.
Compile fixed evaluation fixtures and representative Working Sets with both old and candidate versions.
Challenge candidate against Survival Set, authority rules and known incidents/negative phenotypes.
Owning steward records accept/reject/supersede decision; Human Accepted remains separate where human authority is required.
Promote an explicit ACTIVE head with rollback pointer. Existing historical compiled manifests continue replaying their pinned versions.

observability_and_eval_hooks: COMPILATION TRACE: exact source/layer versions, recipe/program/compiler versions, selected and omitted context, authority/privacy labels, budgets and digests.
CONTEXT QUALITY: evidence-slot coverage, insufficiency, stale/superseded selection, hidden high-authority conflict, contamination and minimality.
EXECUTION QUALITY: contract conformance, factual/evidence traceability, write-scope obedience, tool failures, return completeness and task-specific tests.
METHOD QUALITY: compare program/recipe versions on regression fixtures, successor/model replacement, poisoned/irrelevant context, critique-repair loops and recovery cases.
COST/FIT: prompt bytes/tokens, retrieved records, compile latency, execution latency and context waste are diagnostics, never substitutes for correctness/authority.
REPLAY: re-run exact historical manifest with pinned source revisions/versions versus REFRESH using current admissible heirs; never conflate the two.
anti_monoculture: Keep many small composable programs/recipes by cognitive role instead of one universal mega-prompt.
Separate semantic program from provider/model adapter so replacing a model does not rewrite the method.
Permit competing candidate programs and A/B/adversarial evaluations before promotion; do not require one style to own every task.
Use clause-level Active Method composition where possible so a new recipe cannot erase unrelated proven constraints.
Make Working Set/task-specific compilation the default; never inject all Product Memory into every prompt.
Use critics/challengers and fresh-successor tests to detect self-consistent but brittle prompt families.
Preserve negative results and retired versions as evidence so failed prompt patterns are not rediscovered.
minimum_survival_implementation: Define versioned schemas for Cognitive Program, Recipe and Compiled Prompt Manifest.
Implement a deterministic compiler that consumes exact authority heads + Context Foundry Working Set and emits prompt text + manifest together.
Implement validators for authority leakage, privacy, required evidence, conflict preservation, write scope and output schema.
Create a tiny registry with explicit ACTIVE pointers and promotion receipts; no implicit latest-wins.
Add fixed archaeology/critique/verification/reincarnation fixtures and replay-vs-refresh tests.
Only after those contracts are stable add adaptive recipe selection, learned routing, semantic optimization or aggressive auto-tuning.
